title: Add GET /transactions/{id} test coverage
description: GET /transactions/{id} has no automated test. Add pytest coverage for the found and not-found paths.
acceptance: tests/test_api.py covers 200 with a matching body and 404 for an unknown id. ruff + pytest green. README 'Demo notes' updated.

title: Refunds: POST /transactions/{id}/refund
description: Ops need to refund a completed transaction. Create a REFUNDED status and a refund endpoint that creates a reversing transaction (accounts swapped, same amount/currency, reference 'Refund of <id>') and marks the original REFUNDED.
acceptance: 201 with the reversing transaction; 404 unknown id; 409 if already refunded. Tests for all three. Endpoint table row in README.

title: Filter GET /transactions by currency and status
description: Add optional query params currency= and status= to GET /transactions. Invalid values return 422.
acceptance: Filters combine with AND. Tests for each filter and the 422 path. README row updated.

title: Migrate jobs/reconcile_ledger.py onto app.scheduler
description: Port the nightly ledger reconciliation script onto the in-app scheduler per the legacy-job-migration skill. Delete the script and crontab line.
acceptance: GET /ops/jobs lists reconcile_ledger with schedule '0 2 * * *'. Dry-run test with drift and without drift. Decimal amounts, no os.system, no utcnow().

title: Migrate jobs/export_settlements.py onto app.scheduler
description: Port the settlement CSV export per the legacy-job-migration skill. Output dir must be configurable; dry-run writes nothing.
acceptance: GET /ops/jobs lists export_settlements. Test uses tmp_path. Idempotency (already exported) covered.

title: Migrate jobs/refresh_fx_rates.py onto app.scheduler
description: Port FX rate refresh per the legacy-job-migration skill. Replace pickle cache with JSON, add request timeout, inject the HTTP client for tests.
acceptance: GET /ops/jobs lists refresh_fx_rates. Test with a fake client covering success and provider-unavailable.

title: FX provider timeout returns 500 to callers
description: POST /ops/incidents/fx_timeout reproduces the production symptom: an FX provider timeout surfaces as an unhandled 500. Callers should get a 503 with a Retry-After header and the error should be logged once with the provider name.
acceptance: 503 + Retry-After for fx_timeout; other scenarios unchanged; test added.
